title: Nitrate Rise Rate Between Water Changes
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), auto-top-off events (`ato:event`), dosing and feeding events (`doser:event`, `reeftank:feeding`), planted-tank CO2 (`plantedtank:co2`), quarantine observations (`quarantine:observation`), frag lighting (`fraglight:reading`), and leak telemetry (`leaksensor:event`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, GHL, ESPHome, leak sensors, dosing systems, planted-tank controllers, quarantine logs, and PAR meters streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reeftank:param metric="nitrate"
| sort 0 _time
| streamstats current=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time by tank
| eval rise_ppd=round((value-prev_value)/((_time-prev_time)/86400),2)
| stats avg(rise_ppd) as avg_rise_ppd by tank
description: Estimates how quickly nitrate rises between measurements so feeding load and export balance are easier to judge.
value: Rise rate is more actionable than the raw value alone because it shows how fast the tank is drifting away from stability.
implementation: Log nitrate measurements or automated sensor estimates over time and calculate the day-by-day slope for each tank.
visualization: Table of average nitrate rise per day by tank.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how quickly nitrate is creeping up in each tank between water changes or cleanups.
